Path of a JSON Schema shipped with the package

Source: R/capsule_cli.R
schemapath.Rd

The capsule files are described by JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) documents in the package's schemas folder, the same files as the spec folder of the rmbl GitHub Action: capsule for data_provenance.json, bundle for capsule_bundle.json and manifest for a results manifest. rmbl verify checks each capsule file against its schema before the package's own checks.

Usage

schemapath(name)

Arguments

name

Character scalar: "capsule", "bundle" or "manifest", with or without the .schema.json ending.

Value

The path of the installed schema file, a character scalar. Error: any other name.

See also

blcli (the verify verb), vrfcps.

Examples

schemapath("capsule")
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmpa9Hd7d/temp_libpath1f9279286a56/rmoriebricklayer/schemas/capsule.schema.json"
s <- fromjs(paste(readLines(schemapath("bundle")), collapse = "\n"))
s$required
#> [1] "files"           "manifest_digest" "bundled_utc"     "attestation"    

# only the four schemas exist
try(schemapath("nope"))
#> Error : schemapath: `name` must be capsule, bundle, manifest or ledger, not 'nope'
